message.reasoning:
With doubles I'll get another roll, and cash is tight at $35 though I could mortgage if needed. I'm weighing trades—p1 wants my Virginia to complete pinks, while I need Illinois from p3 to pair with my Kentucky and Indiana for reds. Giving Virginia to p1 would hand them a monopoly, so I'm leaning toward pursuing the deal with p3 instead.

I think offering Reading Railroad for Illinois makes sense since p3 already has Short Line and railroads seem valuable to them; it'd give me a red monopoly even if I can't build on it right away. If that doesn't work, I could sweeten it by throwing in Virginia too, since it still has trade value with p1 as a backup plan.
